empty.title: Agent delivery activity will appear here automatically.
empty.body: StateSeal reads supported local session logs and workspace metadata without hooks, proxies, blocking, approval, or code changes.
error.title: StateSeal could not load delivery records
runs.title: Agent delivery panorama
runs.description: See what changed, which checks support the current state, where evidence breaks, and why a finding was raised—without controlling the Agent.
runs.search: Search task, repository, Agent, or evidence posture…
runs.noMatch: No delivery sessions match the current filters.
insight.noCriticalBody: This is an observational statement, not an approval or semantic-correctness claim.
graph.title: Delivery evidence graph
graph.help: Request → observed code states → checks and artifacts → Agent completion claim. Tool-level noise stays in the audit timeline.
findings.title: Diagnostic findings
findings.help: Facts and reproducible correlations are separated from inferred explanations.
findings.empty: No diagnostic finding was produced from the available signals.
changes.title: Observed changes
changes.help: File changes attributed only when supported by transcript events.
changes.empty: No supported file-mutation event was observed in this session.
checks.title: Checks and evidence freshness
checks.help: A passed check is meaningful only for the observed state on which it ran. Coverage completeness is not asserted.
checks.empty: No recognized test, build, lint, typecheck, or static-analysis command was observed.
artifacts.title: Observed artifacts
artifacts.help: Reports, documents, images, and archives created during the session.
artifacts.empty: No supported delivery artifact was observed.
timeline.title: Audit timeline
timeline.help: A sanitized, read-only projection of Agent-owned local events.
